entities.summary: Ananda Mahidol, a notable figure in the history of Thailand, associated with Constitutional Revolution and World War II (1944–1957). Preceded by Free Thai Movement and Country renamed from Siam to Thailand ('Land of the Free'). Their legacy influenced King Ananda Mahidol (Rama VIII) found shot dead in mysterious circumstances.
